# CLI commands

Usage: `cognito-kit <command> [options]`

## init

Generate a starter auth configuration

Options:

- `--sign-in <mode>` — sign-in mode: "email" or "username"
- `--application <type>` — application type: "web", "spa" or "mobile"
- `--callback-url <url>` — callback URL (repeatable)
- `--logout-url <url>` — logout URL (repeatable)
- `--name <name>` — application name (default: app)
- `--output <dir>` — output directory (default: ./auth)
- `--yes` — use defaults for anything not provided (non-interactive)

## doctor

Analyze a Cognito configuration and report dangerous or poor choices

Options:

- `--file <path>` — path to a normalized pool JSON document
- `--config <path>` — path to an auth.config.ts (developer-facing config)

## dev

Run the local OIDC development server

Options:

- `--port <port>` — port to listen on (default: 9876)
- `--host <host>` — host to bind (default: 127.0.0.1)
- `--issuer <url>` — issuer URL override
- `--users <path>` — path to a users file (.json or .ts)

## test

Validate an auth configuration

Arguments:

- `config` — path to the auth config file (default: ./auth/auth.config.ts)

## migrate

Analyze and plan a Cognito migration (planned for a future release)

## deploy

Deploy the generated infrastructure to your AWS account (planned for a future release)
